split_method: Each split is random.Random(seed).shuffle of its goal range taken in order, skipping a goal whose instruction names more than one ASIN, whose ASIN or normalized instruction an earlier split holds, and in unique_asin splits one whose ASIN the split holds (tools/prepare_webshop.py)
notes: Final: checked against the real goals of the server image (goal count, order equal to human_goals.json, seed 42 before SimServer), with every pinned goal field; the server refuses to serve when any differs.

best_reward is the reward of buying the gold product with the goal's options; gold_search_rank is its 0-based rank among the top 50 when the instruction is searched (null: not found). Items are not filtered.
